description: Early initialization settings for pakro. These settings are loaded before the main config files.

ceiling_paths.description: Directories where pakro stops searching for config files.

env.description: Env to use for pakro.<PAKRO_ENV>.toml files.

env_conf_d.description: Enable environment-specific filenames in conf.d directories.

ignored_config_paths.description: This is a list of config paths that pakro will ignore.

override_config_filenames.description: If set, pakro will ignore default config files like `pakro.toml` and use these filenames instead.

override_tool_versions_filenames.description: If set, pakro will ignore .tool-versions files and use these filenames instead. Can be set to `none` to disable .tool-versions.

title: pakro rc config
